profile.name: A2D多功能检测板
profile.description: 这是一种用于实验室电学测试的多功能检测电路板，可测量电压、电流和温度，并支持校准。它适合嵌入测试夹具、原型系统或自动化实验平台中，用于基础信号采集与状态监测。
profile.description_en: This is a multifunction measurement board for laboratory electrical testing. It can measure voltage, current, and temperature, and supports calibration. It is suitable for integration into test fixtures, prototype systems, or automated lab setups for basic signal acquisition and condition monitoring.
